method_note: Run inline by the lead-scraper agent (planner, collectors, judge done by one agent with WebSearch/WebFetch/curl; no sub-agents). Apify MCP tools were NOT available in this session (ToolSearch found none), so Apify spend is 0. Google Maps, Justdial, Wheree and Instagram cannot be read without a login or are blocked (403 / login wall), so Google review dates and owner replies could NOT be observed for any lead; no browser-UA spoofing was used.
